author: ButtonSmasher_
body:
When appealing for a temp-ban/ban on the Avicus Network please include the following: 
  • Your minecraft username(most recent name if changed) ButtonSmasher_
  • The reason you were temp-banned/banned: Fly hacking
  • Why you should be unbanned from the server: I can't remember that i used hacks maybe sometime back, and YES i did hack on some servers! But really i don't do that anymore! I'm re-born or something and i really want to fix and just play skywars... Because like this is the only server that has a good amount of players with fun...
There are some things to think about before making an appeal.
  • Was my temp-ban or ban really false? I think it was true... Because yeah i did use hacks in the past... But like i didnt even ment to use hacks... I just wanted to have fun and yeah it leaded to a ban.
  • Do i have any evidence to show the staff if was false. Idek if the staff has evidence?
  • Have i waited long enough to be un-banned. Well it says that i haven't played 7 months so 7 months
  • Have i been caught ban evading? Idk?
  • Have i appealed a ban before? I think this was my first server to be banned on with a good reason... xD
